objective: neutral THCA-A crystal in neat limonene at 298.15 K

inputs.cosmo_dGsolv_reference: openCOSMO-RS 24a, gas 1 M -> liquid 1 M standard states
inputs.cosmo_dGsolv_source: current openCOSMORS-cli recheck using the explicit no-polarizability input; dGsolv matches the saved CLI output

COSMO_AAD_only_sensitivity.interpretation: 0.45 kcal/mol dataset-AAD sensitivity only; not a confidence interval
0.45 kcal/mol dataset-AAD sensitivity only; not a confidence interval

combined_sensitivity_envelope.interpretation: 20-100 cm-1 Einstein external-mode bracket plus/minus COSMO 24a dataset AAD; not a statistical interval and excludes major crystal-method systematics

limitations: The originally named thca-cp2k-singlepoint job exited 137; a separate diagonalization crystal single-point completed. The solubility cycle uses the completed constrained-H geometry optimization instead.
CIF heavy-atom coordinates and cell are from the 120 K experimental structure; the cell and heavy atoms were fixed and only hydrogens relaxed at PBE-D3(BJ)/SZV-MOLOPT-SR-GTH.
The periodic SZV basis has no completed larger-basis convergence check and no BSSE correction; the DZVP periodic attempt was killed for resource use.
Crystal phonons are not computed. Six external modes are represented by 20 and 100 cm-1 Einstein scenarios; intramolecular crystal vibrations are assumed equal to gas conformer 1 and cancel.

The NIST RRHO ensemble covers 293 database conformers and reproduces the reported 2.2 kJ/mol conformational enthalpy, but low-frequency anharmonicity, conformer validation and solution conformer reweighting remain uncertain.

The supplied ORCA_COSMO_TZVPD descriptors predate the ORCA 6.0 descriptor workflow. Polarizability mode 7 is incompatible; results use the explicit no-polarizability compatibility path and the 24a parameter values, so the published 0.45 kcal/mol AAD is only a benchmark sensitivity, not target-specific uncertainty.

The deployed REST endpoint reproduces the mode-0 activity coefficients but does not accept dGsolv_* parameters; the type-4 dGsolv was rechecked with the container's CLI. A direct polarizability-mode-7 request closed the connection on these legacy descriptors.
The reported mass units assume a neat-limonene density of 0.84 g/mL and dilute-solution volume additivity.
